title: Malaysia Oil and Gas ESG Monitoring
thesis: Snowflake turns daily facility data from a fictional Malaysian oil and gas operator into effluent-quality, emissions-intensity, methane leak closure and grievance KPIs, 7-day exceedance-risk scores, oil-in-water anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Effluent samples within threshold, environmental exceedances, emissions intensity and community grievances for 30 facilities across 4 Malaysian regions.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to facility-day rows. Thresholds are internal demo thresholds, not regulatory limits.
The root-cause chart shows that boil-off gas flaring puts the most effluent samples over the threshold.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of ESG KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which facilities are likely to have the next exceedance?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each facility's probability of an environmental exceedance in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags effluent oil-in-water outliers per facility, and the forecast projects operator-wide CO2e emissions for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: How healthy are the controls behind those risks?

talking_points: Effluent treatment uptime and methane leaks closed frame the operator's environmental control capacity.
Inspection completion against effluent within threshold by facility is a synthetic association, not evidence of cause.
The action memo is drafted from the KPI, exceedance, root-cause and risk tables only, and needs human review.
tabs.call_out: From KPIs to a reviewed action memo in one place

transition.line: What is happening at the facilities right now?

talking_points: Live effluent oil-in-water and flare-load readings land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the simulator or from AWS IoT Core through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the facility's current risk band, then emails the environmental officer.
tabs.call_out: From alarm to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic exceedance-response SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
